name: Bubble
tagline: Bubble is a no-code visual programming platform that lets non-developers build fully functional web applications with custom logic, databases, and user authentication. Its AI assistant can generate page layouts and data structures from a natural-language description. Bubble hosts tens of thousands of production apps, from SaaS MVPs to marketplace platforms.
